gaps: No scheduled maintenance: no VACUUM, log pruning, cache eviction or orphan-row cleanup.
Semantic index is never regenerated automatically and has no manual trigger reachable from the UI.
Interrupted repository operations are detected but never resumed; repository_recovery_checkpoints is never written.
No panic hook: a panicking background thread dies silently (the swarm scheduler is individually protected; others are not).
